# Nepal relief standard - figures read from the scanned PDF (20 Oct 2026)

Document: Ministry of Home Affairs, "Disaster-victim rescue and relief (seventh amendment) standard, 2077 BS" (about 2020/21). File: data/external/costs_norms/nepal_moha_standard/2022-08-01_10-41-48.pdf (5 pages, scanned image, no text layer).
Method: read by eye from page images (no Nepali OCR). Amounts are written in Nepali words, which helps accuracy. NOT double-checked by a second reader: have a Nepali reader confirm before the figures go in the thesis or the RBI evidence.
Unit: NPR. 1 lakh = 100,000.

| Item | Amount (NPR) | Page / clause |
|---|---|---|
| Death in a household (first death) | 2 lakh (200,000) | p2, 2(ka) |
| Each further death in the same household | +1 lakh per person | p2, 2(ka) |
| Immediate cash, house/shelter/food/land/shop damaged, family up to 5 members | 15,000 | p2, 2(kha) |
| Same, family with more than 5 members | 20,000 | p2, 2(kha) |
| New house at a safe place, house destroyed or unsafe | up to 1 lakh per family | p3, 2(cha) |
| Injured: treatment paid; on discharge | 1,000 per person + travel | p3, 2(chha) |
| Relief running costs (Chief District Officer) | up to 5,000 | p4, 2(ta) |
| Epidemic health supplies from district fund | up to 1 lakh | p4, 2(da) |
| District Disaster Management Fund minimum balance | Himalayan 4 lakh, hill 5 lakh, Terai 7 lakh | p2, 1(gha) |

## Rules and limits
- Relief only for incidents reported within 30 days (p4).
- If a household has no survivor, this clause pays no relief (p2).
- Housing for families made homeless by flood/landslide: same assistance as the 2015 earthquake victims via the Ministry of Urban Development; the amount is NOT in this document (p3).
- Only the amended clauses are listed: no rates for crop loss, livestock loss or partly damaged houses.
- Later amendments after 2077 BS: not verified.
- Amounts are NPR from about 2020/21. India norms are INR; any comparison needs a stated exchange rate and year.
